name: Arithmetic & Geometric Progressions (AP & GP)
roadmap: Start by mastering the general term and sum formulas for both AP and GP. Progress to understanding the sum to infinity for convergent geometric series. Finally, apply these concepts to real-world scenarios like financial modeling and logarithmic sequences often found in DSE Section B.
roadmap_zh: 從掌握 AP 和 GP 的通項與求和公式開始。進階到理解收斂等比級數的無限項之和。最後，將這些概念應用於 DSE 乙部常見的現實場景，如財務模型和對數數列。

concepts.name: Golden Rule 1: AP Constant Difference
concepts.name_zh: 黃金法則 1：AP 恆等公差
concepts.key_takeaway:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> In an **Arithmetic Progression (AP)**, the difference between any two consecutive terms is a constant $d$. 
> $T_n = a + (n-1)d$ 
> $S_n = \\frac{n}{2}[2a + (n-1)d]$
concepts.key_takeaway_zh:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> 在**等差數列 (AP)** 中，任意兩個連續項之間的差是一個常數 $d$。
> $T_n = a + (n-1)d$
> $S_n = \\frac{n}{2}[2a + (n-1)d]$

concepts.name: Golden Rule 2: GP Constant Ratio
concepts.name_zh: 黃金法則 2：GP 恆等公比
concepts.key_takeaway:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> In a **Geometric Progression (GP)**, the ratio of any two consecutive terms is a constant $r$.
> $T_n = ar^{n-1}$
> $S_n = \\frac{a(r^n - 1)}{r - 1}$
concepts.key_takeaway_zh:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> 在**等比數列 (GP)** 中，任意兩個連續項的比是一個常數 $r$。
> $T_n = ar^{n-1}$
> $S_n = \\frac{a(r^n - 1)}{r - 1}$

concepts.name: Golden Rule 3: Sum to Infinity Condition
concepts.name_zh: 黃金法則 3：無限項之和條件
concepts.key_takeaway:
> [!CAUTION]
> The **Sum to Infinity ($S_\\infty$)** ONLY exists if the common ratio satisfies $|r| < 1$. If $|r| \\ge 1$, the series diverges and the sum is undefined.
concepts.key_takeaway_zh:
> [!CAUTION]
> **無限項之和 ($S_\\infty$)** 僅在公比滿足 $|r| < 1$ 時存在。若 $|r| \\ge 1$，級數會發散，總和未定義。

concepts.name: Logarithmic Sequences
concepts.key_takeaway: If $x, y, z$ is a GP, then $\\log(x), \\log(y), \\log(z)$ is an AP with common difference $\\log(r)$. This is a common trap in DSE Section B.
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: 若 $x, y, z$ 是 GP，則 $\\log(x), \\log(y), \\log(z)$ 是一公差為 $\\log(r)$ 的 AP。這是 DSE 乙部常見的陷阱。

concepts.name: Solving for $n$ using Logs
concepts.key_takeaway: When solving inequalities like $r^n > K$, remember to flip the inequality sign if you divide by $\\log(r)$ and $r < 1$ (since $\\log(r)$ is negative).
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: 解如 $r^n > K$ 的不等式時，若除以 $\\log(r)$ 且 $r < 1$，請記住要反轉不等號（因為 $\\log(r)$ 是負數）。
